display.title: Shiva Asar B'Tammuz: How Baseless Hatred Destroyed the Beis HaMikdash
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi explains what happened on the 17th of Tammuz, why our Sages say baseless hatred caused the Churban, and how Ahavas Yisroel will bring Moshiach.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given the week of Shiva Asar B'Tammuz. Uncle Yossi explains that on the 17th of Tammuz an army surrounded Yerushalayim, cutting off food and water, and that this siege began the Three Weeks and led to the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash on the ninth of Av. Our Sages ask why this happened, and answer: baseless hatred, the opposite of the mitzvah to love your fellow as yourself, which Rabbi Akiva called a great rule of the Torah. Hashem rests among His children only when they live in unity, so the order of the day for every soldier of Tzivos Hashem is to strengthen Ahavas Yisroel, discourage quarrels and spread love. This will bring Moshiach, when the sad days will become Yomim Tovim. The clip ends by noting that the holiness of Shabbos lingers until Tuesday, an echo of the Yud-Beis Tammuz celebration.
display.lesson: Baseless hatred caused the Churban; strengthen Ahavas Yisroel and unity to bring the Geulah.
